data.name: StringRecorderKBLinkDescription
data.value: To update your recording servers, follow these instructions:

data.name: StringReason
data.value:
An important security patch is available.
Make sure all recording servers are updated with the security patch before you continue this upgrade. Continuing without updating the recording servers, will cause the recording servers to fail.

data.name: WarningPageHeadingDetails
data.value: Evidence locks will not work until recording servers are upgraded

data.name: WarningPageBodyDetails
data.value: The recording servers from the previous versions will not support the creation, modification, or deletion of evidence locks.

data.name: WarningPageBodySubsection
data.value: Upgrade your recording servers to the new version.

data.name: StringNextAction
data.value: Without the security patch, the recording servers cannot communicate with the management server after the system upgrade.

data.name: StringCheckBoxAccept
data.value: The security patch is installed on all recording servers
